title: Expected runtime of repeated runs
statement: Let $t$ be a positive integer and let $q$ be a randomized procedure that, on a string of $t$ bits, either returns an output or does not halt. Suppose a uniformly random $t$-bit string makes $q$ fail to halt with probability at most $1/2$. Run $q$ repeatedly on successive blocks of $t$ bits, stopping at the first block on which it returns an output; the sum, over every finite cutoff $K$, of the probabilities that this procedure has not halted after $s$ bits for each $0 \le s < K$ is at most $2t$.
hypotheses_covered: A uniformly random $t$-bit string makes $q$ fail to halt with probability at most $1/2$
